C0797.title: Microsoft Investigates Stealthy Intrusion via Third-Party Vendor Management Relationships
C0797.summary: Microsoft's security team released a case study detailing a stealthy intrusion that exploited third-party vendor management relationships, identity infrastructure, and operational tools. Attackers moved laterally through trusted third-party systems and maintained long-term access to the enterprise environment, evading conventional detection methods.
